assembly.pi_datum: Pi centred XY, PCB bottomZ0, connector at+X32.5mm
assumptions: Mounted visual reconstruction, not a manufacturing bend-radius specification
Only thin flexible layers, routed copper and the .12mm black laminated circuit backing follow the fold
Connector stiffener, camera-head stiffener, discrete components and optics remain rigid
.12mm adhesive layer is an assembly assumption and conforms to modelled underside relief
Finite visual CSI housing limits insertion to2.05mm; original22 fingers are not wholly hidden
Small CSI spring/FPC contact overlap is visual preload, not a validated physical deflection model
Continuous equal-developed-length half ellipse is a visual routing assumption; manufacturer bend-radius and backing-film stiffness remain unverified
assembly.normal_offset_method: Planar-ellipse Frenet sweep for constant-width films; inverse-arc-length normal-offset loft for variable-width copper
assembly.chord_deviation_scope: Neutral curve96 equal-arc-length chords; CAD films use a smooth sweep
assembly.camera_rigid_transform_scope: Legacy key applies only to the 202 underside/head rigid source parts; it is not the transform for every rigid camera part.
assembly.rigid_transform_units: mm; maps original centred ZeroCam source coordinates to Pi assembly coordinates

independent_smooth_fold.CAD_sweep_witness_method: 450 independently calculated normal-offset boundary points; analytic reference distinct from OCC ellipse sweep approximation
independent_smooth_fold.geometry_preservation_method: Only root OCCT Free bit excluded; all other geometry/topology text/tokens compared <=1e-12, volume/topology/analytic bounds/vertices independently checked

render_fold_replacement_preservation.fingerprint_definition: SHA256 of positions, topology, split loop normals, named UV layers, world transform, material-slot names and polygon material indices
render_fold_replacement_preservation.old_bend_shape_type: two quarter circles with a vertical straight section
render_fold_replacement_preservation.new_bend_shape_type: continuous half ellipse without a vertical straight section
